screen.name: MessageBox-template-4
screen.applet:
from __future__ import division from enigma import eSize, ePoint, getDesktop, eRectangle, gFont from Tools.TextBoundary import getTextBoundarySize
# Abstände und Größen offset_listposx = 30 offset_listposy = 180 offset_listwidth = 30 selection_listwidth = 1050
# Muss mit itemHeight="54" übereinstimmen offset_listheight = 54
offset_textwidth = 340 offset_textheight = 40 offset_titlewidth = 124
# Bildschirmauflösung deskwidth = getDesktop(0).size().width() deskheight = getDesktop(0).size().height()
maxheight = int(deskheight * 0.75) min_width = 800 min_height = 100
titlewidth = 0
# Größe des Fragetextes textsize = self["text"].getSize() textwidth = textsize[0] + offset_textwidth textheight = textsize[1] + offset_textheight
listwidth = 0 listheight = 0
# Höhe der Antwortliste if self.list: listheight = len(self.list) * offset_listheight
if listheight > maxheight: listheight = maxheight
if min_height > textheight: textheight = min_height
if listheight > 0: offset = 43 else: offset = 27
try: # Benötigte Breite des Titels ermitteln for key, value in self["Title"].master.skinAttributes: if key == "font": font = value.split(";")
title = self.windowTitle
if self.timeout > 0: title = f"{title} ({str(self.timeout)})"
titlewidth = getTextBoundarySize( None, gFont(font[0], float(font[1])), self["Title"].master.instance.size(), title, True ).width()
# Benötigte Breite der Antworten ermitteln if self.list: for key, value in self["list"].skinAttributes: if key == "font": font = value.split(";")
for item in self.list: width = getTextBoundarySize( None, gFont(font[0], float(font[1])), self["list"].instance.size(), item[0], True ).width()
if width > listwidth: listwidth = width
listwidth += offset_listwidth * 2
except Exception: pass
# Mindestbreite if min_width > textwidth: textwidth = min_width
# Breite für den Titel berücksichtigen if titlewidth + offset_titlewidth > textwidth: textwidth = titlewidth + offset_titlewidth
# Breite für die Antworten berücksichtigen if listwidth + offset_listposx > textwidth: textwidth = listwidth + offset_listposx
wsizex = textwidth + offset_listposx * 2 wsizey = textheight + listheight + offset
# Fensterhöhe begrenzen if wsizey + offset_listposy - offset_listposx > deskheight: textheight = ( deskheight - listheight - offset - offset_listposy + offset_listposx )
wsizey = textheight + listheight + offset
# Fensterbreite begrenzen if wsizex > deskwidth: textwidth = deskwidth - offset_listposx * 2 listwidth = deskwidth wsizex = deskwidth
wsize = ( wsizex, wsizey + offset_listposy - offset_listposx )
# Fenstergröße setzen self.instance.resize(eSize(*wsize))
# Fragetext anpassen textsize = ( textwidth, textheight )
self["text"].instance.resize(eSize(*textsize))
# Titel korrekt positionieren und ausrichten titleposx = 108 titleposy = 12 titleright = 20 titleheight = 80
titlesize = ( max(1, wsizex - titleposx - titleright), titleheight )
self["Title"].master.instance.move( ePoint(titleposx, titleposy) )
self["Title"].master.instance.resize( eSize(*titlesize) )
# Antwortliste positionieren if self.list: available_listwidth = wsizex - offset_listposx * 2 current_listwidth = min(selection_listwidth, available_listwidth) current_listposx = max( offset_listposx, int(wsizex - current_listwidth) // 2 )
listsize = ( current_listwidth, listheight )
self["list"].instance.move( ePoint( current_listposx, textheight + offset_listposy ) )
self["list"].instance.resize( eSize(*listsize) )
# Fenster zentrieren newwidth = wsize[0] newheight = wsize[1]
self.instance.move( ePoint( int(deskwidth - newwidth) // 2, int(deskheight - newheight) // 2 ) )
# Zusätzliche Hintergrundelemente anpassen for widget in self.additionalWidgets: if isinstance(widget.instance, eRectangle): widget.instance.resize(eSize(*wsize))
